title: H4463 (122nd General Assembly): Firearm

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2017-12-13; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess122_2017-2018/prever/4463_20171213.htm (LegiScan doc 1663185))
provenance.note: Introduced version (Dec. 13, 2017); no later version or vote on file.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new Section 16-23-540): (B) It is unlawful for a person who owns property or who is the lawful occupant of property located in unincorporated areas of the State to engage in the discharging of a firearm on his property, or who permits such activity involving the discharging of a firearm by others on his property, without appropriate safety measures in place.
Section 1 (new Section 16-23-540): A person who violates the provisions of this section is guilty of a misdemeanor and, upon conviction, must be fined not more than five hundred dollars or imprisoned not more than thirty days.
